period: c.1934 North Atlantic liner, first-class grand saloon

nouns.noun: ship's engine-order telegraph on a display plinth
nouns.materials: polished brass pedestal and dial housing, black-and-white enamelled dial face, brass handles, a low square macassar ebony plinth
nouns.subject: A ship's engine-order telegraph as a decorative display piece: a tapered brass pedestal column rising from a low square macassar plinth, topped by a round brass housing holding a large enamelled dial with the order sectors (FULL, HALF, SLOW, STOP, ASTERN) marked in black on white, two brass lever handles standing up from the housing's sides, a small brass bell beneath the dial.
nouns.avoid: ship's wheel, compass binnacle, clock, lamp, legible modern text,
